# InstitutionalVaultRegistry
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/InstitutionalVaultRegistry.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IInstitutionalVaultRegistry](../interfaces/i-institutional-vault-registry.md), Ownable

**Title:**
InstitutionalVaultRegistry

Single source of truth registry for institutional vault wiring.

Governor-managed via ProtocolAccessManaged. Stores component addresses keyed by institution id.
Update policy:
- Only AdmiralsQuarters is updatable in-place
- Other components are immutable; perform replacement with a new institution id instead
Soft-disable preserves visibility and auditability of old institutions.


## State Variables
### institutions
Maps each institution identifier to its registered Institution record


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 => IInstitutionalVaultRegistry.Institution) public institutions
```

### getBytes32InstitutionId

VIEW

This is a raw cast: strings longer than 32 bytes are truncated; shorter strings are right-padded with zeros.
Use only if the naming convention guarantees <= 32 bytes and deterministic casing/encoding.


```solidity
function getBytes32InstitutionId(string calldata name) public pure returns (bytes32);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`name`|`string`|Human-readable institution name (UTF-8)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes32`|id bytes32 identifier suitable for on-chain keys|

|----|----|-----------|
|`id`|`bytes32`|The institution identifier|


### getInstitution

Returns the full institution wiring for institution with id `id`

Reverts if the institution does not exist


```solidity

    returns (IInstitutionalVaultRegistry.Institution memory institution);
```
**Parameters**

**Returns**

|`institution`|`IInstitutionalVaultRegistry.Institution`|The institution's wired component addresses|
